depiction.composition: two opposing arrows arranged diagonally, lower-left pointing right and upper-right pointing left

reasoning: The icon depicts two offset horizontal arrows pointing inward at each other, commonly understood as compare/diff, swap/exchange, or merge/combine. While somewhat abstract, it fits action-driven tasks like comparing quotes, swapping shifts, exchanging goods or currency, and merging files or branches. It can occasionally be confused with UI collapse/minimize arrows or generic sync icons.
